blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
We present WildAnySplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that enables robust novel-view synthesis from in-the-wild multi-view images. Unlike controlled captures, real-world images often contain multi-view inconsistencies caused by transient occluders, illumination changes, and camera ISP, which degrade the quality of existing feed-forward reconstruction methods.
  To address this challenge, we introduce a student-teacher framework that learns transient-robust and appearance-consistent 3D representations. A teacher network operates on clean images, while a student processes the corresponding in-the-wild inputs. The teacher provides clean supervision to guide the student toward a consistent canonical representation. Since paired clean and in-the-wild data are scarce, we use a hybrid data strategy, combining real paired captures, synthetic augmentations, and pseudo-clean labels generated from optimization-based reconstructions, bridging the domain gap between synthetic and real-world data.
  We adopt a transformer architecture with dedicated DPT heads for camera pose, depth, and Gaussian prediction. We additionally predict per-view transient masks to reweight photometric supervision and suppress unreliable Gaussians. To account for cross-view appearance variation, we incorporate a bilateral grid module that models per-image color transformations and enables recovery of a canonical radiance representation.
  Experiments on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks show that WildAnySplat improves robustness to transient occlusions and appearance variation while retaining the fast inference of feed-forward Gaussian Splatting.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction methods have recently made significant progress in enabling fast novel-view synthesis from multi-view images ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . In particular, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) has emerged as a powerful representation due to its rendering efficiency and high visual fidelity, and various follow-ups have adapted foundational 3D models to decode Gaussian primitives ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Moreau et al., 2026 ) . However, existing feed-forward approaches largely assume consistent multi-view observations, limiting their applicability to controlled capture settings.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward 3D重建方法最近取得重大进展,能够从多视图图像中快速合成小说(Wang等人,2025a); 蒋等,2025). 特别是3D高斯白板(3DGS)(Kerbl等人,2023年)因其渲染效率高,视觉忠贞度高而成为强大的代表,各种后续作品也调整了基础3D模型,以解码高斯原始人(Jiang等人,2025年;Moreau等人,2026年). 然而,现有的向信息传输方法在很大程度上假定了一致的多视图观察,将其应用限制在可控捕获设置上.

blocks.en: In contrast, real-world image collections, such as those found in internet photo datasets, exhibit substantial multi-view inconsistencies. These include transient occluders (e.g., pedestrians, vehicles), illumination changes across time, and camera-dependent color processing. Such effects violate the assumptions of multi-view consistency and lead to degraded geometry, color artifacts, and ghosting in reconstructed scenes.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,真实世界的图像收藏,如在互联网照片集中发现的图像,则显示出重大的多视图不一致。 这些包括瞬态的占卜器(如行人,车辆),跨时间的照明变化,以及依赖相机的色彩处理. 这种效应违反了多景一致性的假设,导致几何学退化,色彩文物,在重建的场景中幽灵化.

blocks.en: While optimization-based methods such as NeRF in the Wild ( Martin-Brualla et al., 2021 ) and WildGaussians ( Kulhanek et al., 2024 ) address these challenges through per-scene fitting and explicit robustness mechanisms, they incur high computational cost and are unsuitable for real-time or large-scale deployment. Feed-forward approaches, on the other hand, remain brittle under these conditions due to their inability to disentangle transient and persistent scene components.
blocks.zh: 虽然基于优化的方法,如Wild的NERF(Martin-Brualla等人,2021年)和WildGoussians(Kulhanek等人,2024年),通过每个场面的合适和明确的强性机制来应对这些挑战,但它们需要高昂的计算成本,不适合实时或大规模部署. 另一方面,在这种条件下,饲料前进方法仍然很简陋,因为它们无法将瞬态和持久性的场景部件分开。

blocks.en: In this work, we propose WildAnySplat , a feed-forward framework that explicitly models and mitigates multi-view inconsistencies in in-the-wild images. Our method builds upon the AnySplat architecture and introduces three key components. First, we predict per-frame transient masks that identify unreliable regions, which are used both to reweight training losses and to guide voxelization fusion of Gaussians. Second, we model per-image color transformations via learned bilateral grids, enabling recovery of a consistent canonical appearance across views. Third, we use a student–teacher training framework with hybrid supervision, where a teacher network operating on clean observations provides stable geometric supervision to a student trained on in-the-wild inputs.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出 WildAnySplat, 一种向导的框架, 它明确模型和减轻多视图的不一致 在模糊的图像。 我们的方法建立在AnySplate架构之上,并引入了三个关键组件. 首先,我们预测可识别不可靠区域的每帧瞬态口罩,这些口罩既用于重估训练损失,也用于指导高斯人血氧化聚变。 其次,我们通过学习过的双边网格来模拟每个图像的颜色转换,从而能够恢复一个横跨视线的一致的犬形外观。 第三,我们使用一个学生-教师培训框架,由混合监督,一个在清洁观测上运作的教师网络向接受过无边际投入培训的学生提供稳定的几何监督。

blocks.en: A central challenge in this setting is the absence of ground-truth supervision for clean, transient-free observations. To address this, we combine large-scale synthetic augmentation with pseudo supervision derived from optimization-based methods. Specifically, we generate synthetic transient artifacts and color perturbations during training, and further leverage outputs from methods such as WildGaussians to provide pseudo-clean images and uncertainty maps. This hybrid supervision strategy enables our model to generalize effectively to real-world in-the-wild data.
blocks.zh: 在这一背景下的一个中心挑战是缺乏对清洁、瞬间观测的地面实况监督。 为了解决这个问题,我们把大规模合成增强与基于优化的方法所产生的伪监督结合起来。 具体来说,我们在训练期间生成合成的瞬态文物和色彩扰动,并进一步利用WildGausians等方法的输出来提供伪清洁图像和不确定地图. 这种混合监督战略使我们的模式能够有效地向现实世界的迷信数据概括。

blocks.en:
Our results demonstrate that WildAnySplat achieves improved robustness relative to the AnySplat backbone and competitive performance among current feed-forward in-the-wild methods, with the
largest quantitative gains occurring on dynamic RealX3D captures.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果显示,WirdAnySplat相对于AnySplat主干网,实现了更高的稳健性,以及当前向导的Win-wild方法之间的竞争性能。
在动态 RealX3D 捕获上发生的最大数量收益。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (1) Unified handling of in-the-wild inconsistencies in feed-forward 3DGS. A student–teacher framework learns transient-robust and appearance-consistent canonical 3D representations from inconsistent multi-view images. (2) Transient-aware Gaussian fusion via learned masks. Per-view transient masks enable robust photometric supervision and suppress unreliable Gaussians during voxel fusion. (3) Spatially-varying appearance modeling with bilateral grids. Per-view bilateral grids model cross-view appearance variation, enabling recovery of a canonical appearance. (4) Hybrid supervision with synthetic augmentation and pseudo labels. Combining transient and ISP augmentation with pseudo labels from optimization methods addresses limited paired supervision and the synthetic-to-real domain gap.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: (1)统一处理饲料向导3DGS的内在矛盾. 学生-教师框架从不一致的多视图图像中学习瞬变-robust和外观一致的立体表达。 (2)通过学习的口罩进行瞬间感知高斯核聚变. 透视瞬间口罩可以实现强光度监督,并在输氧液聚变过程中抑制不可靠的高斯人. (3)以双边网格进行空间变化的外观建模. 泛视双边网格模型跨视的外观变异,使得一个犬形外观得以恢复. (4)配有合成增强和伪标签的混合监督。 将瞬态和ISP扩增与优化方法的伪标签相结合,解决了有限的配对监管和合成-现实域间隙.

blocks.en: 1.1. Related Work
blocks.zh: 1.1. 相关工作

blocks.en: 1.1.1. Optimization-based Novel View Synthesis in the Wild
blocks.zh: 1.1.1. 野外基于优化的小说视图合成

blocks.en: Opt-imization-based methods have been the dominant approach for handling in-the-wild image collections due to their flexibility in modeling inconsistencies. NeRF in the Wild ( Martin-Brualla et al., 2021 ) introduced per-image appearance embeddings to account for illumination and color variation across images, with transient regions handled by uncertainty estimation. Subsequent methods further improved reconstruction quality, efficiency, and sparse inputs ( Barron et al., 2021 ; Barron et al., 2023 ; Verbin et al., 2022 ; Niemeyer et al., 2022 ; Ren et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 基于Opt-imization的方法由于在建模不一致方面的灵活性,因此是处理闪烁的图像收藏的主导方法. NERF in the Wild (Martin-Brualla et al., 2021)引入了逐象外观嵌入法,以说明图像之间的照明和颜色变化,瞬态区域由不确定性估计处理. 随后的方法进一步提高了重建质量,效率和投入稀少(Barron等人,2021年;Barron等人,2023年;Verbin等人,2022年;Niemeyer等人,2022年;Ren等人,2024年;Lin等人,2024年).

blocks.en: Recent methods based on 3DGS explore similar approaches. Methods such as GS-W ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , Wild-GS ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , SWAG ( Dahmani et al., 2024 ) , and WildGaussians ( Kulhanek et al., 2024 ) incorporate robust loss functions, visibility modeling, or uncertainty estimation to handle occlusions and inconsistent observations. SpotlessSplats ( Sabour et al., 2025 ) and DeGauss ( Wang et al., 2025c ) explicitly address distractors by separating static and dynamic components or filtering transient artifacts during optimization. While these methods achieve strong performance, they rely on computationally expensive per-scene optimization and are therefore not suitable for real-time or large-scale applications.
blocks.zh: 基于3DGS的近期方法探索了类似的方法. GS-W(Zhang等人,2024年),Wild-GS(徐等人,2024年),SWAG(Dahmani等人,2024年),WildGoussians(Kulhanek等人,2024年)等方法都包含了强大的损失功能,能见度模型化,或不确定性估计,以处理隐含和不一致的观测. SpotlessSplats(Sabour等人,2025年)和DeGauss(Wang等人,2025年c)通过在优化期间分离静态和动态组件或过滤瞬态文物,明确处理分散器. 虽然这些方法能实现强性能,但是它们依赖于计算成本昂贵的每场优化,因此不适合实时或大规模应用.

blocks.en: 1.1.2. Feed-forward Novel View Synthesis
blocks.zh: 1.1.2. Feed-forward 小说视图综合

blocks.en: Recent feed-forward approaches enable faster, generalizable reconstruction by learning mappings from input images to scene representations. Early works such as pixelNeRF ( Yu et al., 2021 ) and MVSNeRF ( Chen et al., 2021 ) learn generalizable radiance field predictors from sparse views. More recently, feed-forward approaches have been extended to 3DGS ( Moreau et al., 2026 ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Charatan et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ) , enabling efficient inference with high rendering quality. Recent pose-free methods such as AnySplat ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) and DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) demonstrate that transformer-based architectures can jointly predict camera poses, depths and Gaussian representations directly from multi-view inputs. Although somewhat robust to minor inconsistencies, these approaches still assume consistent multi-view observations and struggle with heavy occlusions and appearance variation.
blocks.zh: 通过学习从输入图像到场景表现的绘图,最近采用的向导方法能够更快、普遍地进行重建。 早期的作品如pixelNERF(Yu等人,2021年)和MVSNERF(Chen等人,2021年)从稀疏的视野中学习一般的辐射场预测器. 最近,饲料推进方法扩大到3DGS(Moreau等人,2026年;Hong等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年;Tian等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年b;Charatan等人,2024年;Chen等人,2024年;Liu等人,2025年b),从而能够有效地推论出高质量的产品。 近期的无假名方法如AnySplate(Jiang等人,2025年)和DA3(Lin等人,2025年)表明,基于变压器的架构可以直接从多视图输入中共同预测相机的姿势,深度和高斯的表示. 尽管这些方法有些强壮,有些小的不一致,但是它们仍然具有一致的多观点观察,与严重的隐蔽和外观变化作斗争。

blocks.en: 1.1.3. Feed-forward Novel View Synthesis in the Wild
blocks.zh: 1.1.3. 野外饲料向前小说视图合成

blocks.en: Several recent works extend feed-forward NVS methods to unconstrained settings. GenWildSplat ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) and Sparse-View 3DGS in the Wild ( Li et al., 2025a ) address the challenge of generalization to real-world image collections with varying capture conditions, but focus on sparse views. WildSplatter ( Fujimura et al., 2026 ) introduces appearance control mechanisms for feed-forward 3DGS, while WildRayZer ( Chen et al., 2026 ) explores self-supervised learning for large-scale dynamic environments. Wild3A ( Li et al., 2025b ) further demonstrates fast feed-forward reconstruction in dynamic scenes.
blocks.zh: 最近几部作品将feedward NVS方法扩展至不受约束的设置. GenWildSplat(Gupta等人,2026年)和Sparse-View 3DGS in the Wild(Li等人,2025年a)解决了对捕捉条件不同的现实世界图像收藏的泛化挑战,但专注于稀有的视图. WildSplater (Fujimura et al., 2026)引入了向导3DGS的外观控制机制,而WildRayZer (Chen et al., 2026)则为大规模动态环境探索自我监督的学习. Wild3A(Li等人,2025年b)进一步展示了动态场景中快速的饲料前进重建.

blocks.en: Despite this progress, existing methods typically address only subsets of the challenges present in in-the-wild data. Handling transient occluders and color inconsistencies are often treated independently, and supervision remains limited due to the lack of ground-truth clean observations. Notably, GenWildSplat uses a pretrained segmentation network ( Jocher et al., 2023 ) to predict transient masks, rather than detecting occluders that are truly multi-view inconsistent. WildRayZer predicts motion masks and masks input tokens prior to entering the reconstruction network, rather than learning unified, robust 3D reconstruction at the representational level.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有方法通常只处理大量数据中存在的部分挑战。 处理瞬态闭塞和颜色不一致的问题往往得到独立的处理,由于缺乏地面真实的清洁观测,监督工作仍然有限。 值得注意的是,GenWildSplat使用预先训练的分片网络(Jocher等人,2023年)来预测瞬态口罩,而不是检测真正多视不一致的吞噬者. 疯狂 筽 Zer在进入重建网络前预测运动口罩和口罩输入符,而不是在代表级别学习统一,强大的立体重建.

blocks.en: Our work differs from these approaches in three key aspects. First, our clean-teacher/in-the-wild-student training strategy maintains more robust reconstruction and pose estimation in the presence of inconsistent inputs. Second, we jointly model transient occluders and spatially-varying appearance from multi-view inputs via learned masks and bilateral grids, influencing both training and Gaussian fusion. Third, we introduce a hybrid supervision strategy that combines synthetic augmentation with pseudo ground-truth signals derived from optimization-based methods, bridging the gap between synthetic and real-world data.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作在三个主要方面与这些办法不同。 第一,我们的清洁教师/大学生培训战略保持更强有力的重建,并在投入不一致的情况下作出估计。 第二,我们通过学习的口罩和双边网格,联合模拟瞬变的占卜器和空间变化的外观,影响培训和高斯聚变。 第三,我们采用混合监督战略,将合成增强与基于优化的方法产生的伪地面真实信号结合起来,缩小合成数据和现实世界数据之间的差距。

blocks.en: 1.1.4. Appearance Modeling and Color Consistency
blocks.zh: 1.1.4. 外观模型和颜色一致性

blocks.en: Modeling appearance variation across views is critical for in-the-wild reconstruction. While optimization-based methods ( Martin-Brualla et al., 2021 ; Kulhanek et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) typically learn per-image latent variables or affine color corrections jointly during reconstruction, recent work explores harmonizing images before or after reconstruction. PPISP ( Deutsch et al., 2026 ) uses a learned post-processing module for radiance field rendering that models common photometric variations, e.g. exposure, white-balance, CRF etc. Difix3D+ ( Wu et al., 2025 ) enhances NVS renderings through single-step diffusion. ( Alzayer et al., 2025 ) employ a diffusion-based relighting model to match images with illumination variations to a given reference image prior to NeRF reconstruction. Similarly, CHROMA ( Shin et al., 2026 ) proposes feed-forward bilateral grid prediction for consistent multi-view appearance harmonization prior to scene-specific 3DGS. We build on this idea by integrating bilateral grid prediction into a fully feed-forward 3DGS framework, allowing us to recover canonical Gaussian colors while compensating for per-image appearance variation.
blocks.zh: 不同观点的模型化外观差异对于万象重建至关重要。 虽然基于优化的方法(Martin-Brualla等人,2021年;Kulhanek等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年)通常在重建期间共同学习每个图像的潜在变量或近缘颜色校正,但最近的工作探索了重建之前或之后的图像协调. PPISP(Deutsch等人,2026年)使用一个学习到的处理后模块进行辐射场渲染,模拟常见的光度变化,例如暴露、白平衡、通用报告格式等。 (Wu等人,2025年)通过单步传播增强NVS渲染. (Alzayer等人,2025年)在NERF重建之前,采用了一种基于扩散的再照明模型,将带有照明变体的图像与特定的参考图像相匹配. 同样,CHROMA(Shin等人,2026年)提议在场景特异性3DGS之前,对一致的多视图外观进行向导双边网格预测. 我们以这一想法为基础,将双边电网预测纳入一个完全向导的3DGS框架,使我们能够在补偿每幅图像的外观变化的同时,恢复犬科高斯的颜色。

blocks.en: 2. Method
blocks.zh: 2. 国家 方法

blocks.en: 2.1. Overview

Figure 2. Method overview. WildAnySplat trains a student network to reconstruct feed-forward 3D Gaussians from in-the-wild images containing transient occluders and appearance variation. A frozen clean-image teacher provides camera and depth supervision, while the student predicts Gaussians, transient masks, and per-view bilateral grids. The transient masks downweight unreliable regions during photometric training and voxel fusion, while bilateral grids map canonical Gaussian renderings into each input image’s appearance domain, enabling robust geometry and consistent canonical colors.
blocks.zh: 图 2. 方法概述。 WildAnySplat训练一个学生网络,以重建来自闪烁的图像中的向导3D Gaussians,这些图像包含瞬变形器和外观变异. 冷冻的清真影像老师提供摄像头和深度监督,而学生则预测高斯人,瞬间口罩,以及每个视图的双边网格. 瞬间在光度训练和阴道聚变过程中掩盖了不可靠的区域,而双边网格则将 canonical Gaussian 渲染图映射到每个输入图像的外观域,从而能够形成坚固的几何和一致的犬形颜色。

blocks.en: Given a set of in-the-wild multi-view images { I i } \{I_{i}\} exhibiting significant cross-view inconsistencies, our goal is to predict a 3D Gaussian representation that enables high-quality novel-view synthesis.

To address this challenge, we propose WildAnySplat , a feed-forward 3DGS framework trained using a student–teacher paradigm. The student network operates on in-the-wild inputs, while a frozen teacher network processes corresponding clean observations obtained from synthetic augmentation, optimization-based pseudo-clean reconstructions, and a small set of real-world paired captures. The teacher provides stable geometric supervision in the form of camera poses and depth predictions, guiding the student toward more robust geometry under real-world inconsistencies.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出“WildAnySplate ” ( WildAnySplate ) , 即一个利用学生-教师模式培训的向导3DGS框架。 学生网络运行于无间隙输入,而一个冷冻的教师网络处理从合成增强中获取的相应清洁观测,基于优化的伪清洁重建,以及一小组真实世界对接的捕获. 该教师以照相机姿势和深度预测的形式提供稳定的几何监督,引导学生在现实世界不一致的情况下更坚固几何.

blocks.en: Our framework consists of three key components: 1) feed-forward Gaussian prediction, 2) transient-aware masking and Gaussian voxel fusion, and 3) per-view appearance modeling via learned bilateral grids, all trained under the student–teacher framework. An overview of our framework is shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们的框架包括三个主要组成部分: 1) 向导高斯预测,2) 瞬间感知蒙面和高斯声波聚变,3) 透過學習双边网格的透视外观模型,全部在学生-教师框架下接受训练. 图2概述了我们的框架。

blocks.en: A major challenge in training robust in-the-wild reconstruction models is the lack of paired supervision consisting of corrupted input images and corresponding clean observations. To address this, we generate clean and in-the-wild pairs using synthetic augmentation (transient object and camera ISP variation) and pseudo-clean supervision from optimization-based reconstruction as follows.
blocks.zh: 在培训强力的 " 万无一失 " 重建模式方面的一项重大挑战是缺乏由腐败的输入图像和相应的清洁观测组成的对联监督。 为了解决这个问题,我们利用合成增强(易碎物体和相机ISP变异)和从优化基础上的重建中产生的伪清洁监督,产生干净的和万无一失的对子:

blocks.en: 2.3.1. Synthetic Transient & ISP Augmentation
blocks.zh: 2.3.1. 合成转移和ISP增强

blocks.en: To simulate transient occluders commonly observed in in-the-wild images, we augment clean training images by randomly inserting 2D objects sampled from the COCO dataset ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . Specifically, we randomly select segmented foreground objects and alpha-composite them into the training views with randomized scale, position, and appearance perturbations. For each augmented image, we additionally generate ground-truth transient masks corresponding to the inserted objects, which are used to supervise the transient mask prediction (Sec. 2.2.2 ).
blocks.zh: 为了模拟在模糊的图像中通常观察到的瞬态振荡器,我们通过随机插入从COCO数据集取样的2D物体来增强清洁训练图像(Lin等人,2014年)。 具体地说,我们随机选择了分块的前缘物体,并用随机的尺度,位置,和外观扰动将它们混合到训练视图中. 对于每个增强的图像,我们额外生成与插入的物体相对应的地面真伪瞬间口罩,用来监督瞬间口罩的预测(第2.2.2条)。

blocks.en: In practice, we found that naively pasting segmented objects into images produced unrealistic artifacts that were too easy for the network to detect. To improve realism and better approximate real-world transient occluders, we additionally apply several appearance adaptation operations to the pasted objects, including boundary blurring, noise injection, and affine color matching to the local background region. These augmentations encourage the model to learn semantic transient reasoning rather than relying on low-level copy-paste cues.
blocks.zh: 在实践中,我们发现,天真地将片面物体粘贴在图像中,会产生不切实际的文物,这些文物太容易被网络发现. 为了改进现实主义和更近似现实世界的瞬变器,我们还对被粘贴的物体进行了几次外观适应操作,包括边界模糊、噪声注入和与本地背景区域相匹配的外观颜色。 这些增强鼓励模型学习语义性瞬间推理,而不是依赖低级的复制-复制提示.

blocks.en: To further improve robustness to appearance inconsistencies, we apply randomized ISP-style color augmentations, including exposure shifts, white balance changes, saturation variation, contrast perturbations, vignetting, and local color transforms. Together, these augmentations simulate the lighting and camera-processing variations commonly encountered in casually captured imagery. Examples of our synthetic paired training data are shown in Fig. 3 .
blocks.zh: 为了进一步提高外观不一致的稳健性,我们采用了随机化的ISP风格的色彩增强,包括暴露移位,白色平衡变化,饱和变化,对比扰动,调色,以及局部色彩变换. 这些增强装置共同模拟了在偶然捕获的图像中常见的照明和照相机处理变化。 我们的合成配对培训数据实例见图3。

blocks.en: 2.3.2. Pseudo Clean Image Supervision
blocks.zh: 2.3.2. Pseudo清洁图像监督

blocks.en: To help close the domain gap between real and synthetic data, we construct an additional dataset of paired in-the-wild and pseudo-clean images using hold-out scenes from the Phototourism ( Snavely, 2006 ) and Dynamic-RE10K ( Chen et al., 2026 ) datasets. Specifically, we employ WildGaussians ( Kulhanek et al., 2024 ) and render transient-suppressed pseudo-clean images from the resulting reconstructions. For each training image I i w I_{i}^{w} , we obtain 1) a pseudo-clean target image I i c I_{i}^{c} rendered from the optimized WildGaussians reconstruction, and 2) uncertainty maps indicating unreliable or poorly reconstructed regions, e.g. transient regions. These pseudo-clean renderings serve as teacher supervision within our student–teacher framework, enabling the student network to learn transient-invariant canonical scene representations while remaining exposed to realistic in-the-wild degradations. Importantly, the scenes used for pseudo-clean supervision are disjoint from the evaluation scenes used in our experiments. Examples of our pseudo-clean paired data are shown in Fig. 3 .

We train on four GPUs with
140 GB of VRAM for 35k iterations, using AdamW optimizer and cosine learning rate scheduler, with a peak learning rate of 2e-5 and a warmup of 2k iterations. As in-the-wild data and heavy augmentation can destabilize training, we accumulate gradients over every 4 batches. Training datasets are sampled at random every iteration and we use a dynamic batch-size sampler that randomly samples between 2 and 16 frames, with a maximum input resolution of 448 × 448 448\times 448 px. We predict bilateral grids at a resolution of 16 × 16 × 8 16\times 16\times 8 . The teacher network uses pretrained VGGT weights and remains frozen throughout training. blocks.en: 4. Limitations
blocks.zh: 4. 限制

blocks.en: Despite strong performance, WildAnySplat has several limitations. First, although our model improves robustness to distractors, it can still struggle in scenes containing large or persistent dynamic regions. When moving objects dominate the scene, pose and reconstruction quality can degrade due to insufficient static observations.
blocks.zh: 尽管性能很强,但WildAnySplate有多个局限性. 首先,虽然我们的模式提高了分散注意力者的稳健性,但它仍然可以在包含大型或持久动态区域的场景中挣扎. 当移动的物体在现场占据主导地位时,由于静态观测不足,姿势和重建质量可以降解.

blocks.en: Second, our bilateral-grid appearance model primarily captures low-frequency spatially-varying color transformations. Extreme illumination changes, strong view-dependent effects, or highly non-linear camera processing may not be fully modeled, leading to residual appearance inconsistencies.
blocks.zh: 其次,我们的双边网格外观模型主要捕捉低频空间变色变色. 极光变化,强烈的视线依赖效应,或高度非线性相机处理可能无法完全建模,导致剩余外观不一致.

blocks.en: Third, we rely on optimization-based methods to generate teacher supervision for real-world scenes. Although this supervision is computed offline, generating pseudo-clean ground truth introduces additional preprocessing cost and the student may inherit biases or artifacts from the teacher.
blocks.zh: 第三,我们依靠基于优化的方法,为现实世界的场景产生教师监督. 虽然这种监督是离线计算的,但产生伪的清洁地面真相会带来额外的预处理费用,学生可以从教师那里继承偏见或文物。

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结论

blocks.en: We have presented WildAnySplat , a feed-forward framework for robust 3DGS from in-the-wild images. Our method addresses two key challenges in unconstrained multi-view reconstruction: transient occlusions and cross-view appearance variation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了 WildAnySplat , 即一个向导框架, 我们的方法解决了在不受限制的多景区重建中的两个关键挑战:瞬间隐蔽和交叉景区外观变化.

blocks.en: To achieve this, we introduced transient-aware masking for robust Gaussian aggregation and supervision, bilateral-grid appearance modeling for canonical color reconstruction, and a student–teacher training framework that leverages clean supervisory signals derived from synthetic augmentation and optimization-based methods.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这一目标,我们引入了用于强壮的高斯聚合和监督的瞬间感知面具,用于犬色重建的双边网格外观模型,以及利用合成增强和优化方法产生的清洁监督信号的学生-教师培训框架。

competitive performance among feed-forward 3DGS methods across varied capture
conditions.
